clue.text: Cat a waterbird mostly observed going round tree

indicators.note: mostly means the last letter of the bird's name is dropped
going round turns the whole string so that it reads from right to left

blocks.note: a tom is a male cat
taken as written
a grebe is a diving waterbird

explanation.surface: A cat is seen circling a tree after a waterbird.
explanation.definitionFit: The bergamot is a citrus tree whose fruit gives the oil that flavours Earl Grey tea.

clue.text: Tax catches King Edward in drill

indicators.note: catches means the tax word holds the royal abbreviation inside it

blocks.note: excise is a duty charged on goods
ER, Edwardus Rex, is the cipher of a King Edward

explanation.surface: A levy falls on a monarch during military training.
explanation.definitionFit: A drill is a repeated practice routine, so it is a synonym of a training exercise.

clue.text: Someone to take high level command? Count Agrippa out

definitions.text: Someone to take high level command?

indicators.note: out signals that these letters are put out of order and rearranged

blocks.note: taken as written: the twelve letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A question about who should take charge, then the instruction to remove a nobleman named Agrippa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'High level' hints at the air: the rank belongs to the RAF.
explanation.definitionFit: A group captain is a senior RAF officer, and an air force commands from on high, literally.

clue.text: Criminal heading north on famous horse

indicators.note: in a down clue, heading north means the letters are read from the bottom upwards

blocks.note: RE means on or about, as in a letter heading
Red Rum won the Grand National three times

explanation.surface: A villain rides off north on a celebrated racehorse.
explanation.walkthrough: Red Rum is a celebrated British steeplechaser, winner of the Grand National in 1973, 1974 and 1977.
explanation.definitionFit: A killer is one kind of lawbreaker, so the answer is an example of the definition.

clue.text: Dehydrated, tense and ill-tempered, beginning to drop

indicators.note: the beginning letter drops: in this down entry it slides one place down the column, rearranging the word

blocks.note: T is the grammatical abbreviation for tense
shirty is British slang for bad-tempered

explanation.surface: Someone parched, tense and grumpy, about to collapse.
explanation.walkthrough: The S at the start of the slang word does not vanish; it drops one place down the column. Shirty is British slang for irritable.
explanation.definitionFit: Being dehydrated means lacking water, which is the state of needing a drink.

clue.text: Bird coming out of racecourse paraded topless before old queen

indicators.note: topless means the first letter is removed; in a down clue the first letter is the top
before places the racecourse remnant ahead of the royal letters

blocks.note: Ascot is a famous racecourse in Berkshire
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the cipher of a former queen

explanation.surface: A bird emerges from the racecourse where an elderly queen once paraded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coming out of' and 'paraded' are padding for the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The scoter is a dark sea duck, so it is an example of a bird.

clue.text: One who's against first couple of ancient relations turning up

indicators.note: in a down entry, turning up reads the letters from the bottom upwards

blocks.note: the opening two letters of the word ancient
IT is a coy word for sexual relations

explanation.surface: An opponent of old family ties coming to light.
explanation.definitionFit: The word works as a noun for an opponent of something, an objector.

clue.text: This tape could be used, with student's input, to make telecasts

indicators.note: could be used signals that letters can be rearranged into the word that follows
the student's input is the letter added; taking it back out of the rearranged letters leaves the answer
to make points to the word these rearranged letters would form

blocks.note: the nine letters of this word
L is the learner driver's plate letter

explanation.surface: An instruction for a student to use this tape to record broadcasts.
explanation.walkthrough: A composite anagram: the answer plus the learner's L rearranges to make the last word, so take the L out and rearrange the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: A cassette is a small case holding magnetic tape for recording sound or video.

clue.text: ICE about to intercept worker arriving at American ranch

indicators.note: about here means the letters are turned around and reordered
to intercept means the jumbled letters cut into the middle of the worker and American
arriving at puts the worker first, then the American abbreviation

blocks.note: a hand is a farm worker
A is a standard abbreviation for American
taken as written

explanation.surface: Immigration agents stop a farmhand reaching an American ranch.
explanation.walkthrough: ICE in the surface is the US immigration agency.
explanation.definitionFit: A hacienda is a large estate or farm in Spanish-speaking countries, a Latin American ranch.

clue.text: Turned out dire heads in middle of March

indicators.note: turned out means the insides are thrown out, leaving the first and last letters
heads means the leading letter of each word

blocks.note: only its first and last letters
the first letter of each of these two words

explanation.surface: Things became grim by the middle of March.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Middle of March' reads as a date, but its two first words only supply initial letters and March is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A demo is short for demonstration, a protest march through the streets.

clue.text: Suffering duress, United must supply reserves

indicators.note: suffering means the letters are under strain and so knocked out of order

blocks.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A football club under pressure must field its substitutes.
explanation.definitionFit: Understudies are actors who learn a part to stand in if needed, so they are standbys.

clue.text: Poor Domenico Scarlatti gutted — mass regularly put out of service

indicators.note: poor signals that these letters are in a bad state and rearranged
gutted means the insides are removed, leaving only the outer letters
regularly takes every other letter

blocks.note: taken as written
only its first and last letters
its alternate letters

explanation.surface: Pity the composer Domenico Scarlatti, devastated as his mass gets scrapped.
explanation.definitionFit: To decommission is to withdraw a ship, weapon or plant from active use.

clue.text: Description of movement up in certain circles

indicators.note: circles means these words surround the answer, which sits within them

blocks.note: the run of letters holding the answer

explanation.surface: Talk of a movement that is on the rise in some social groups.
explanation.walkthrough: A pincer movement is a military manoeuvre attacking from both flanks.
explanation.definitionFit: The word describes a military manoeuvre in which two forces close on the enemy from both sides.

clue.text: Defector shot commanding officer about to be discharged

indicators.note: discharged means emptied: the inner letters go, leaving the first and last

blocks.note: a turn is a go or a shot at something
CO is the abbreviation
only its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A deserter shoots his commanding officer, who is about to leave the army.
explanation.definitionFit: A turncoat is someone who switches to the opposing side, a traitor.

clue.text: Catty sort of secretary doing duty for Tesla's outside in skintight clothing

indicators.note: doing duty for means one thing stands in for another, a replacement

blocks.note: a leotard is a close-fitting garment for dancers
the first and last letters of the name Tesla
PA is a personal assistant

explanation.surface: A spiteful assistant stands in for an executive at Tesla, dressed in tight clothing.
explanation.definitionFit: A leopard is a big cat, so it is a sort of feline; catty here means cat-like.

clue.text: £1 notes, not one new, in circulation, I hear

indicators.note: one N, the abbreviation for new, is left out
in circulation means the letters go round, the last one coming to the front

blocks.note: L, from libra, is the pound, and 1 is the Roman numeral I
tenners are ten-pound notes

explanation.surface: A man boasts of passing round banknotes, but none of them new, so he says.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is spoken by the answer itself: someone who hears says 'I hear'. A tenner is a ten-pound note.
explanation.definitionFit: A listener is a person who hears, so the words are what such a person would say.

clue.text: Metropolitan spread straddles border

indicators.note: straddles means the paste sits on both sides of the edge

blocks.note: pâté is a meat or fish spread
a rim is an edge

explanation.surface: A city-dweller's spread is laid across a border.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Metropolitan' looks like a city adjective but is a church title: the archbishop of a province.
explanation.definitionFit: A metropolitan bishop heads a church province, and primate is the title for such a senior archbishop.

clue.text: Pairs finishing chore made stratagem, escaped, and got back

blocks.note: its final pair of letters
its final pair of letters
its final pair of letters
its final pair of letters

explanation.surface: After finishing the housework, a couple hatched a plan, fled, and were recaptured.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pairs finishing' tells you to take the last two letters of each of the next four words.
explanation.definitionFit: To redeem something is to recover it, as with an item from a pawnshop.

clue.text: Spring lock checks unlawful entry

indicators.note: checks means holds back, as the lock contains the spring

blocks.note: a tress is a lock of hair
a spa is a mineral spring

explanation.surface: A spring-loaded lock stops anyone getting in illegally.
explanation.definitionFit: Trespass is the legal wrong of going onto land without permission.

clue.text: Mounted police to charge public: leader's lacking judgement

indicators.note: in a down clue, mounted means the letters climb, read upwards
to charge means to load into, so the police go inside
the first letter is missing

blocks.note: overt means open, done in public
CID is the Criminal Investigation Department

explanation.definitionFit: A verdict is the decision of a jury or court, its ruling on the case.

clue.text: A case of the Home Counties having a calming effect?

the dative is a grammatical case

clue.text: Logs initially barred from coal fire

its first letter

clue.text: Golf club's right wing becoming Liberal? That's nonsense

the right-hand end letter

clue.text: Fashion designs never wear

blocks.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Fashion designs that nobody would ever put on.

explanation.definitionFit: An evening dress is formal clothing, an example of what one wears.

clue.text: Show old mate where to go at night?

clue.text: Order Charlie, lying about being confronted by head, to omit nothing

being confronted by means the reversed fool faces, and so comes before, the headland
